_about: P02 capture validation. 'packets': layouts corrected or first annotated from captures (they override earlier annotation files that sort before P02.json). 'evidence': opcodes whose existing annotation a capture confirmed field by field, without changing it; an entry may carry a captured variant 'layout' that pcap_decode.py tries when the hand annotation does not fit (W04 0x7C07 short form, 0x7037 tail) (`packets.py` renders each entry as a **Captured** line in packets-<server>.md; capture-validation.md has the full reasoning).
